name: 87507 · Santa Fe, NM
findings: ZIP 87507 (Santa Fe) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87507 (Santa Fe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 87507 (Santa Fe) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
